claims.statement: A $100-a-side fight between Punch Morris and Steve O'Donnell was made up at Tom Allen's saloon on Saturday night.
claims.excerpt: was made up at Tom Allen's saloon on Saturday night

claims.statement: Tom Allen backed Punch Morris in the $100 fight with Steve O'Donnell, and Jack Leoney backed O'Donnell.
claims.excerpt:
The backer of Morris is Tom Al-
len, and jJack Leoney backs O'Donnell.

claims.statement: The forfeit money for the Morris and O'Donnell fight was put up at Tom Allen's saloon.
claims.excerpt: The forfeit money was immediately put up at Allen's.

notes: The Morris-O'Donnell fight is not Allen's own contest, so there is no fight entry. Only his backing and his saloon are about him.
